anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt saying: This month is for you beginning of months; it is first for you in the months of the year.
pass_b_english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying: This month is for you the beginning of months; it is first for you among the months of the year (Exodus 12:1–2).
source_text: Εἶπεν δὲ Κ(ύριο)ς πρὸς Μωϋσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ λέγων· Ὁ μὴν οὗτος ὑμῖν ἀρχὴ μηνῶν, πρῶτός ἐστιν ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς μησὶν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ.
